sentences.zh: 这场斗争的结果，无论党内是否会出现一个班农派（如果你想这么叫的话），

sentences.en: You know, I was very upfront when I left the White House.

sentences.zh: 我们有更好的方式来管理事情。

sentences.en: We're just not going to kind of give it to you.

sentences.en: So, you know, if you've seen what Mitch McConnell and I have been going after each other, his henchmen have been going after me,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果你看到米奇·麦康奈尔和我一直在互相攻击，他的亲信一直在攻击我，

sentences.zh: 由于左翼没有布赖特巴特，也没有真正的新闻机构，

sentences.en: that one of its principal focuses is turning the spotlight on the corruption and incompetence of the Democratic establishment.
sentences.zh: 其主要焦点之一就是揭露民主党建制派的腐败和无能。

sentences.en: I think that's one of the reasons that the revolt by the Democratic left and the progressive left
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是民主党左翼和进步左翼发起反叛的原因之一

sentences.en: against the Wall Street ownership of the Democratic Party and the corruption that they have has been many years in coming.

sentences.en: But I've got to tell you, you can see it coming.
